Two causes are now clear:

1. **Shell-west locks air.** `house()` writes `air` over every interior cell and every opening, so the glazing and room parts are refused there, including the doors.
2. **Plot 4 porch roof.** The porch roof's north overhang reaches the front wall at z 13 and drops slabs at y3 across the door and sidelight cells, so `doorSet` refuses the whole door.

input.summary:
Walk is ok for every room (was 6 rooms unreachable across P3/P4, plus the P0 attic and walk gaps); make.sh passes and writes build.nbt at 128x24x25.
Between-part fixes: shell no longer writes air over openings (that locked 230 glazing/door writes and most room furniture), plot 0 roof restored (roof.json never existed), porch/gambrel/hip eaves no longer drop onto doors or ramps, chimney caps and mouths fixed, plot 2 loft partition and gable walls, attic ladder support, and street lamps. Fit went 36 -> 3; light has no DARK cells in any room.
Left: P3 entry porch 1-wide gap (plan columns at x55/x57), P5 central hearth has no room-side mouth at floor level, 2 pediment "stairs end short" (likely a false positive, not confirmed), 5 dark back-yard cells near x47-50 z23, roof verge orphans, and plot 0 dormers not built.

waste.what: Found the shell's air writes locking every opening by counting refusals, but the runParts report kept only 8 refusedAt entries per part, so I copied the build library to /tmp and patched the cap to see all 230 refused writes.
waste.cost: about 6 probe runs and a throwaway copy of tools/src
waste.tool: runParts report should keep every refused write (or a count plus a full list file) and a flag to print the lock owner per cell

waste.what: Traced each fit fault back to a part by dumping cell columns by hand and grepping cells-by-part JSON for each coordinate, one coordinate at a time.
waste.cost: roughly 40 cell-dump and attribution commands, each covering a few cells
waste.tool: mcd fit should name the part that placed the offending block (use MCD_PARTS_CELLS to attribute it) and print the neighbour list it actually tested

waste.what: Chimney fire checks: a chimney built by chimneyStack passed in isolation only after I changed the cap from slab to full bricks; the checker treats slabs at the mouth course as roof tiles, and the mouth's lintel was dropped by a reserved-mouth exemption in grounds.mjs.
waste.cost: about 8 trial rebuilds and a standalone test grid
waste.tool: a chimney self-test in mcd (chimney built standalone must pass fit) and a fit message that names the chimney cell it counted

waste.what: Roof keep boxes were tuned by trial: each widened keep to the room-side column, then narrowed the attic keep to y10-11 so the hip ridge stays supported.
waste.tool: roof tool option that reports which cells a keep box is holding up, or a support check on keep boxes

waste.what: The plot 4 and 7 eave fascia trapdoors floated past the plot edge and grew the grid to 129 wide; I only found it from the fit output.
waste.tool: build should fail when any part writes outside the site box (SITE_SIZE) instead of growing the grid silently

waste.what: Checked the rooms image by eye; the dollhouse sheet was too small to read at the size returned, so I did not inspect individual furnishings.
waste.tool: mcd rooms --only with a per-room size, or tiles per room

companions.task: check the plot 0 hip ridge and the plot 2 and plot 3 gable verges after the keep changes, and decide whether the roof verge stairs that overhang the walls are wanted.
decide the P5 central hearth: a raised or sunken hearth with a real room-side mouth at floor level, instead of a fire inside the partition.
place the three plot 0 dormers and the interior partitions the plan lists (only the attic ladder stub exists), and confirm the plot 3 entry porch can be walked 2 wide.
light the back-yard gap near x47-50 z23 that stays dark at feet level.

left: P3 entry porch: the plan's columns at x55 and x57 leave a 1-wide walk at z10, so the approach fails the 2-wide standard; needs a plan decision (widen the porch or move the columns).

P5 central hearth at (88,1,18): the fire has no room-side mouth at floor level (floor cell (88,1,19) is kitchen floor), so the fit check reports it shut inside the stack; a sunken or raised hearth is a design decision.
Two fit items 'stairs end short' at (6,11,9) and (9,11,9) are the plot 0 pediment rakes sitting on the tympanum; likely a false positive from the flight heuristic, not confirmed by walking.
Plot 0 roof was never in roof.json; it is now a plain hip with no three gabled dormers and no pediment change; dormers are still missing.
Plot 0 interior partitions are not built (rooms rely on them); only the one-cell attic ladder stub at x11 z18 y6..10 was added.
Five dark cells at feet level in the back-yard gap near x47-50 z23 (site light at y1); not on any path, so left.
Roof verge and overhang stairs read as 35 structure orphans (birch_stairs at x34/x46 etc.); cosmetic, left.
Rooms were not inspected at furnishing detail; the dollhouse sheet was too small to read, so only walk, light and fit were checked per room.
Plot 2 roof refuses 36 writes where the new gable end walls sit; intended (the wall is the gable infill), but the roof edge there is not checked by eye.
